html:
What is beautiful about Da Nang tourism in January is a question that many of you are interested in, because the climate in Da Nang in January is winter, but this is also the end of the rainy season in Da Nang, so the rains have gradually subsided, and this is also the occasion for the New Year festivals to take place vibrantly.

You are planning to travel to Da Nang, you are wondering if Da Nang in January is beautiful and attractive, so to have your own answer like what is beautiful about Da Nang tourism in January, please find out the content below.

Da Nang’s climate in January has light sunshine, cold weather at night and a bit chilly during the day, the temperature ranges from 19 to 28 degrees Celsius, very suitable for tourists to walk around and sightsee.

However, if you travel to Da Nang in January, it will not be convenient for swimming or playing sports on the sea, the weather in Da Nang in January is the end of the rainy season, but there are still some late-season rains, but the short rains do not affect your tour.

Where should you visit when traveling to Da Nang in January?

The first destination you visit is the bridges, this is the pride of the people of Da Nang, with bridges spanning the poetic river, a beautiful check-in spot chosen by many young people.

Dragon Bridge is a bridge that breathes fire and water on weekends, when the night falls, the bridge lights up and many tourists choose to take pictures.

Han River Bridge with a unique design, is a rotating bridge at night, many tourists when coming here often admire the sparkling beauty of the bridge when rotating…

Love Bridge is a bridge chosen by many young people, especially those who choose this place as a place to take wedding photos on their big day, or couples come here and write their wishes on locks and hang them on the bridge, hoping that their dreams will come true.

It can be said that the bridges are unique symbols of Da Nang, will bring visitors unforgettable impressive experiences in the coastal city.

Temple in Da Nang

When coming to Da Nang in January, tourists should visit spiritual tourist attractions, pray for a healthy and peaceful new year for their family, and also admire the peaceful scenery.

Linh Ung Pagoda Da Nang has 3 pagodas in one city, and is located in 3 famous scenic areas: Son Tra, Ngu Hanh Son and Ba Na. Coming here, tourists not only come to pray for peace and health but also admire the peaceful scenery.

Nam Son Pagoda has a unique and modern space, is a spiritual tourist destination chosen by many tourists when coming to Da Nang.

Quan Am Pagoda is a peaceful space, and is a spiritual destination chosen by many tourists when coming to Da Nang. Coming to the pagoda, visitors not only feel the peaceful beauty but also feel their souls become more relaxed.

Markets in Da Nang

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Da Nang in January, visit the markets not only to sightsee or enjoy delicious food but also to buy souvenirs as gifts.

Con Market in Da Nang is a market that sells fresh seafood and many delicious dishes of Da Nang that exude the unique flavor of the Central region.

Han Market: As one of the traditional markets, the market has many items from clothes to jewelry, or souvenirs that visitors will be free to choose.

Son Tra Night Market is a market for those who love shopping, and enjoying night cuisine in a vibrant atmosphere, besides that, visitors can also enjoy the unique culture.

In addition, when traveling to Da Nang in January, you can also immerse yourself in the fireworks festival, the countdown ceremony to welcome the new year in a brilliant fireworks display that will bring you exciting experiences during your vacation.

What to eat when traveling to Da Nang in January

Quang Noodles

A dish that cannot be missed when coming to Da Nang, with chewy noodles made from rice flour with water and broth, raw vegetables, peanuts… mixed together to bring a delicious flavor.

Rice paper rolls with pork

A famous dish in Da Nang, each piece of pork rolled in rice paper with a little vegetable mixed with fish sauce brings a delicious flavor that makes diners remember this famous dish forever.

Banh xeo

Speaking of banh xeo, the name is no longer strange, however, Da Nang banh xeo brings its own deliciousness, the filling is made from meat, shrimp, squid, bean sprouts… with other ingredients that customers combine together to create when enjoying diners will forever remember the cuisine of the Central region.

It can be said that when traveling to Da Nang in January, you not only visit and explore the unique culture, and enjoy delicious food, but this is also a wonderful opportunity for visitors to fully explore the beauty of the city in the cool weather, promising to bring you the most enjoyable vacation in Da Nang.

Above are the experiences of traveling to Da Nang in January. Hopefully, this article will bring you useful things during your tour in the island paradise.
